As it feels like the world is getting crazier by the minute and people have a serious problem distinguishing between fantasy and reality, it's time to add this little statement to my work.

This is a work of FICTION. It has absolutely NO relation to reality, nor should it ever have. I do not encourage any kind of violence against any person, be it physical or psychological. Any model I use, male or female, is a creation of FICTION and is not related to any real person.
If you don't like my work, that's fine. But in that case, please put my handle on your ignore list and get on with your life.
If you like my work, that's fine too. But if you ever get the urge to see something like this in real life, with real people. That is WRONG! Please seek professional help. This is meant to be pure FANTASY! Fiction! NOT REAL!!!

This is a collection of renders out of the monthly reward for my Demon Tier Patreons.
Each month I'll add a couple of random pictures and post them here as preview and to show the progress on sets.
